## Learning Objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Insert new data into tables using various methods
- Delete data based on conditional logic
- Update existing records in place
- Handle data modification conflicts and constraints

This chapter covers how to insert new data and delete existing data using Ibis.

## Introduction

Data manipulation operations like inserting and deleting are fundamental to working
with databases. While Ibis primarily focuses on analytical workloads, it also provides
capabilities for inserting and deleting data.
